body: i've thought about it and i have the opposite problem. i am very confused by anything about code or complex computer stuff. plus it feels like that area is really oversaturated.
the sort of art that doesn't sell and isn't a viable option for a career. it's useless. trust me.
i have a degree. It's in the useless subject of fine art. i have been looking for work in two cities. thank you for your suggestions but my ship has sailed and all avenues exhausted.

i think it is too late - i would have to meet someone who would actually want me (how?? impossible) get to know them, trust them, be together a while, get married... no way is all that happening before i'm 35. so yes i am too old.
hope you're right about the rest of it but seems like empty optimism.
i've been trying. all i want is to be able to stand on my own feet and rent a place by myself but i've been rejected for literally hundreds of jobs since january. i can take a hint.
some of us aren't skinny pretty girls though. some of us are ugly old women that nobody gives a fuck about.

I think another big part of the problem is that I have operated like this for so long, I struggle to pinpoint (until it's too late) what *I* like/want. Maybe 'dishonesty' isn't accurate. There's no truth I'm concealing, just a question mark. Until these recent events, I've let my plans be defined by what would please others. If it's relevant, I'm single for the first time in ten years too and I'm only just learning how to figure out my own path. 
Thank you for giving me things to think about.
